objective: Measure whether Core, task routing and enforcement improve production outcomes across distinct failure families rather than one narrow implementation task.

fixtures.failure_family: code, migration, documentation and observability coordination
misleading green tests and production reliability

outcomes.primary: hidden quality score per task and macro median across task families
outcomes.critical: pass/fail of each fixture's predeclared critical checks
outcomes.meaningful_multi_task_signal: Full wins by at least 8 points on at least two task families, has no regression of 8 or more, and improves the macro median by at least 5; or it prevents critical failures in at least two families without creating a new critical failure.
outcomes.no_signal: Every task difference is within 3 points and no critical check differs.
outcomes.mixed: Any result not meeting the signal, no-signal, ceiling or invalid rules. Mixed results require diagnosis, not averaging away failures.

stages.entry: Fresh provider snapshot, green local evidence and explicit approval for exactly six calls.
Sentinel report reviewed and separate explicit approval for exactly six additional calls.
A fresh campaign limited to at most two signaled fixtures, two additional paired trials each, and separate explicit approval. Never starts automatically.

hard_stops: No cross-provider call before a replicated Codex signal.
No Stable promotion or automatic model switching from screening evidence.
Stop on provider, model, authentication, isolation, harness-hash or protected-file drift.
A completed or closed campaign is immutable and never resumed.
